$comment: The source of sf-context-menu's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/context-menu (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

items.x-note: the older list form; entries is the current one

tabs.x-note: "A|B" in the attribute; the property also takes a list [{id, label}] (the component's own accessor), one member with one type (§4.2)

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

x-summary: The Framework's action menu: data entries with icon, caption, value, shortcut, check, submenu, separator and heading, opened by openFor() into the top layer, anchored, with keyboard, typeahead and focus return. A host may still render its own items and own the lifecycle.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label, settings.role: host attributes, read from the host, never settings (§3.1); the menu's own role getter left the prototype's role alone

events sf-context-menu-open, sf-context-menu-close: were facts sent after the state changed (close was also the placed menu's request to its host); by §19.3 and vocabulary §4 they are the cancelable requests, and the facts are sf-context-menu-opened and sf-context-menu-closed

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-context-menu for every action menu: give it entries and open it with openFor(anchor). It opens below and start-aligned by default, with no tail, in the top layer, on the profile menu's surface. A profile menu is one: a header for the person, a choice row for the theme, a submenu with search for the language.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not hand-make a menu of divs and buttons: the row geometry, roles, keyboard and focus return are this component's
Do not ask for a tail: position and tooltip are deprecated and draw nothing

x-decisions: own-verb-words: search (the host is told the query) and tab (a tab chosen) are verbs of the menu alone; their words are lang events.<verb>.label.
version: 1.3.1 → 1.4.0: added the facts opened and closed, the close reason and the entries' shape; nothing removed.
type-union: tabs is one string member ("A|B" in the attribute); the component's own property also takes a list [{id, label}], so the manifest declares the attribute form (§4.2).

item-shape: entries name their fields with `of` (the fields the template and the menu read: id, text, caption, icon, avatar, initials, shortcut, kind, type, value, lang, keywords, checked, disabled, danger, current, href, keep-open, submenu, search, options); items is the older list of {text, value}.
existing-aliases: compatibility.deprecations (position, tooltip: a menu has no tail since 1.3.0) fold into aliases.json as retired rows; both settings still answer until the date.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows.

examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and studio.scenario.json plus entries with a check, a submenu, a search and a tabbed panel; probe.json drives the arrows, Home, End, Enter, Escape and Tab (gate 16).
css-variables: the eight public variables the sheet already reads (src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json).
side-effects: portal -- an owned menu shows in the browser's top layer, and a submenu is drawn at the end of body (or of the open dialog).

layer: kind surface; it registers through core open-surface-mark while owned, so Escape and an outside press reach it only while it is the top layer; it does not trap focus (Tab leaves and closes it).

dismissing: an owned menu asks before it closes, sf-context-menu-close {reason, unsaved} (§19.3): escape, outside, close (its head's close button), api (a choice, Tab, a script). A placed menu's head button sends the same request for its host to close it, as before. The actions keep their boolean answers (openFor, toggleFor, close) until their callers move -- a leftover.

version 1.4.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.
